name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 54 - Am 38
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 54b. Notes the increasing trend to look into offshoring parts of the Union migration policy; calls on the institutions to explore the idea of developing return hubs outside the Union, and, if necessary, to dedicate appropriate funding to the project
